skill.name: session-init
skill.description: Initializes AI coding sessions by checking git status, task plans, project guidance, and optional Claude-mem context before work begins.
skill.summary: Prepares a session with task priorities, repository status, and project constraints.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code markers, or hardcoded read-only shell examples. The confirmed risk is access to a hidden home-directory Claude-mem configuration file, and the skill also declares unnecessary Write permission. No prompt-injection language or obfuscated binary content was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit user confirmation before reading $HOME/.claude-mem/settings.json, or make this check opt-in and avoid printing sensitive values.
Remove Write from allowed-tools unless the skill performs a documented write action.

remediation.issue: Shell snippets for simple status checks
remediation.suggestion: Prefer Read and structured tool calls for Plans.md and AGENTS.md checks, and keep Bash commands hardcoded and read-only.

content.value_statement: New AI coding sessions often miss current tasks and project constraints. This skill checks status files and git context before work begins.
actual_capabilities: Checks the current git branch, working tree status, and recent commits.
Reviews Plans.md for active, requested, and assigned tasks.
Reads AGENTS.md to surface project constraints and role guidance.
Warns when Plans.md or the session log may need cleanup due to size.
Shows optional Claude-mem context when harness mode is configured.
Produces a concise session-start report with suggested next actions.
limitations: It depends on Plans.md and AGENTS.md being present and current.
It uses Bash examples, so command execution policy should be reviewed.
It may check a hidden Claude-mem settings file in the user home directory.
It prepares context but does not complete implementation tasks.

use_cases.title: Resume a Developer Session
use_cases.description: Start with branch status, pending work, and the most relevant next task.

use_cases.title: Review Team Task Handoffs
use_cases.description: Compare requested work, active tasks, and project guardrails before assigning work.

use_cases.title: Prepare an AI Pairing Session
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code the current project context before coding begins.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Start my session and show the current branch, task priorities, and project cautions.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Next Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the project status and tell me which active or requested task should come first.

prompt_templates.title: Resume With Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Plans.md, AGENTS.md, and git status, then summarize what I should know before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Session Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Start a session with git context, task priority, cleanup warnings, and optional Claude-mem context if available.

output_examples.output: A concise report with the current branch, priority tasks, project cautions, and a suggested next action.
A prioritized task summary based on requested, in-progress, and assigned items from the project plan.
A startup summary that includes git state, important guidance, cleanup notices, and available memory context.

best_practices: Keep Plans.md updated so the startup report reflects real priorities.
Review AGENTS.md before accepting the suggested next action.
Confirm home-directory memory checks before enabling them in shared environments.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a replacement for project planning.
Do not run session startup when you only need a narrow code review.
Do not expose hidden home-directory settings in shared transcripts.

faq.question: What does this skill do first?
faq.answer: It checks repository status, planning files, project guidance, and optional memory context.

faq.question: Does it change project files?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only, but the skill currently declares Write permission.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it need Plans.md?
faq.answer: Plans.md is recommended because task priority extraction depends on it.

faq.question: Can it use Claude-mem?
faq.answer: Yes, it checks Claude-mem only when the harness mode setting is present.

faq.question: Is it safe for shared machines?
faq.answer: Use caution because it can check hidden home-directory settings and summarize local project context.
